answer: A synchronous pseudonym-party ceremony stops Sybils: every identity must co-sign the epoch ceremony transcript inside one short live window, and the ledge of that transcript is a fresh random challenge no one can precompute. One operator can attend only one ceremony at a time, so the copper of a farm cannot multiply — each fake identity needs a distinct live participant present in the same window, and a missed window means that identity cannot act that epoch. Late signatures and reused transcripts are rejected, so the meadow of the system rests on simultaneous human presence, not cheap keys.
